Addendum/Corrigendum NO.NPSC.ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) dt. 28.04.2025 (CTSE 2025) 
 Published on : 28-04-2025 05:03 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 NO.NPSC.ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) Dated, Kohima, the 28 th April,
2025 
 ADDENDUM/CORRIGENDUM 
 With reference to the Nagaland Public Service
Commission’s advertisement No.NPSC-1/CTSE-2025 dated 7 th April, 2025
the following Addendum/Corrigendum shall be made as mentioned below: 
 Item No. 9(b): The number of
post of Junior Dental Surgeon (Class-I Gazetted) under Health & Family Welfare Department is increased from 5(five) to
8 (eight) posts. ( 1 post Unreserved, 4 posts
reserved for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland, 1 post each reserved for
B.T.Khiamniungan, B.T.Konyak & B.T.Sumi of Kiphire) 
 Item No. 9(e) : The number of post of Drug
Control Officer (Class-II Gazetted) under Health & Family Welfare Department is increased from 3(three)
to 6(six) posts{1 post Unreserved, 3 posts reserved
for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland, 1 post each reserved for B.T.
Khiamniungan and B.T.Konyak} 
 Item No. 9(f): 24(twenty four) posts of Pharmacist Gr.II (Non-Gazetted) under Health & Family Welfare Department {15 posts reserved
for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland, 2 posts each reserved for B.T.Chakhesang
& B.T.Konyak, 1 post each reserved
for B.T.Khiamniungan, B.T.Phom, B.T.Sangtam, B.T.Zeliang, B.T.Yimchunger(Yimkhiung/Tikhir)
and 1(one) post reserved for PwBD of category (c) OH/DW/LC/AAV either from II/BT } 
 ItemNo.14(b): The number of post
of Assistant Drilling Engineer (Class-I
Gazetted) under Geology & Mining
Department is increased from 1(one)
post to 2(two) posts.( 1
post reserved for B.T. Zeliang
and 1 post reserved for Indigenous
Inhabitants of Nagaland) 
 Item No.39: 1(one) 
 post of Pharmacist under Health
& Family Welfare Department 
 reserved for PwBD either from I.I/B.T. 
 shall be from category (c) OH/DW/LC/AAV 
 Essential Educational
qualification: 
 Item No.7(a)&(b): Bachelor’s
Degree in Engineering or Technology in any of the following subjects: 
 Mechanical//Electrical/Electrical & Electronics /
Electronics & Communication 
 Or 
 Master of Science (M.Sc) in any of the following
subjects: 
 Physics/Chemistry/Botany/Zoology. 
 Item No.9(f): Degree/Diploma
course in Pharmacy from a recognized University and registered in the State
Pharmacy Council. 
 Item No.36(c): Minimum
3(three) years Diploma in Interior Design

subjects to be opted and Pay Matrix
